Built Specifically for College Document Services

Every capability below is fully implemented in our application, database, and sockets.

Payment Architecture

Two-Stage 50/50 Milestone Escrow

Every request is split into two equal 50% payments: Advance (50%) to initiate work, and Balance (50%) to unlock the completed file after admin upload.

Verified Architecture50% Advance → 50% Balance
Real-Time WebSocket

Dedicated Request Chat Room

Every document request has an isolated 1-on-1 Socket.IO chat channel between student and admin for instant messaging and draft feedback.

Verified ArchitectureRoom-Isolated Sockets
Quotation Engine

In-Chat Custom Quotations

Admin reviews your submitted title, subject, pages, and reference files, then issues an interactive quotation card directly inside the chat in USD ($).

Verified ArchitectureAgreed in 1-on-1 Chat
Cloudinary Security

Locked Document Gatekeeper

Request Lifecycle

From Brief to Decrypted Download in 4 Steps

A transparent 4-stage pipeline directly backed by our database status lifecycle.

PHASE 01PENDING

Submit Request & Guidelines

Fill out task details: subject, semester, page count, deadline, and format (typed or handwritten). Upload reference sheets to Cloudinary.

Step 1: Brief Creation
PHASE 02QUOTED

Admin Chat & Quotation

Open your request room to chat directly with admin. The admin evaluates your guidelines and sends an interactive 50/50 quotation card in chat.

Step 2: Quotation Agreement
PHASE 03IN_PROGRESS

Pay 50% Advance Milestone

Accept the quotation and confirm the 50% advance milestone. The request status updates to IN_PROGRESS, and drafting begins.

Step 3: Advance Escrow
PHASE 04COMPLETED

Pay Final 50% & Unlock

Admin uploads the completed file. Settle the final 50% balance to clear the security lock and download your full-resolution document.

Step 4: Decrypted Delivery
Database status lifecycle: PENDING → QUOTED → IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED
